name: COBALTUM METALLICUM
key_symptoms: Aches; worse, bending head forward. Itching of hairy scalp and beard.
Teeth.--Feel too long. Pain in teeth. Cracks across tongue. Coated white (Ant cr).
Aching in wrist-joints. Shooting into thighs from liver. Weak knees. Trembling in limbs. Tingling in feet. Foot-sweat, mostly between toes.
Pain in back and sacrum; worse while sitting; better, walking or lying. Weakness in legs and backache after emissions.

mind_symptoms: All mental excitement increases suffering. Constant interchange of mental moods.
head_symptoms: Aches; worse, bending head forward. Itching of hairy scalp and beard.

gi_symptoms: Shooting in liver. Pain in spleen.
urinary_symptoms: Pain in right testicle; better, urinating. Emissions without erection. Impotence. Backache in lumbar region and weak legs. Lewd dreams. Pain in end of urethra; greenish discharge; brown spots on genitals and abdomen.
musculoskeletal_symptoms: Aching in wrist-joints. Shooting into thighs from liver. Weak knees. Trembling in limbs. Tingling in feet. Foot-sweat, mostly between toes.
skin_symptoms: Dry and pimply. Pimples about nates, chin, hairy scalp.
